Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Rhode Island, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 31,404 covered jobs
B. 22,336 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Rhode Island statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/44000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
